<style>
  /* --- GLOBAL CARD COLOR THEME --- */
  :root {
    --card-bg: #f4f9fc; 
    --card-border: #031C59; 
    --text-main: #031C59; 
  }

  /* This completely fixes the Dark Mode issue by catching all Quarto theme toggles */
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"], 
  body.quarto-dark,
  [data-bs-theme="dark"] {
    --card-bg: rgba(198, 198, 198, 0.1);
    --card-border: #99ddff;
    --text-main: #f3f3f3;
  }

  /* --- TEACHING & SUPERVISION CARD STYLES --- */
  .teaching-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    border-left: 5px solid var(--card-border); /* Matches the Appointments timeline */
    border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; /* Matches the Appointments timeline */
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    color: var(--bs-body-color);
  }

  .teaching-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 15px rgba(0, 139, 210, 0.15);
  }

  .teaching-card-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    gap: 2rem;
    align-items: center;
  }
  
  .teaching-img-wrapper {
    flex: 0 0 25%;
    max-width: 250px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .teaching-img-wrapper img {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    object-fit: cover;
  }
  
  .teaching-text {
    flex: 1;
  }

  .teaching-text h3 {
    margin-top: 0;
    color: var(--text-main);
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    font-size: 1.4rem;
  }

  .teaching-text h5 {
    color: var(--card-border);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
  }

  .teaching-text p, .teaching-text ul {
    color: var(--bs-body-color);
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
  }
  
  .teaching-text ul {
    padding-left: 1.5rem;
  }

  .teaching-text li {
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }

  /* List specific style for the Supervision section */
  .supervision-list li {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }

  /* Mobile Stacking */
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .teaching-card {
      border-radius: 12px;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      border-top: 5px solid var(--card-border);
    }
    .teaching-card-body {
      flex-direction: column;
      text-align: left;
    }
    .teaching-img-wrapper {
      max-width: 100%;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
  }
</style>

## {{< iconify fa-solid:users >}} &nbsp; Student Mentorship & Supervision

<div class="teaching-card">
<div class="teaching-card-body">
<div class="teaching-text">
<h3>Research & Computational Mentorship</h3>
<h5>LMS (École Polytechnique) & I2M (Univ. Bordeaux) | 2024 - Present</h5>
<p>I actively supervise and mentor junior researchers, focusing on computational modelling, poromechanics, experimental needs, and rigorous software engineering practices (Git, CI/CD testing, code review):</p>
<ul class="supervision-list">
<li><strong>Matthieu Lacour (M2 & PhD - I2M):</strong> Co-supervised M2 internship on micro-fluidic chip design. Currently providing advanced computational mentoring for his PhD on Finite Element modelling using FEniCS.</li>
<li><strong>Gaspard Deremble (L3 - LMS):</strong> Supervising the computational modelling of the cornea, including advanced meshing methods and hyper-elastic material parameter gradients.</li>
<li><strong>Parsa Namazian (M1 - LMS):</strong> Supervising research on the poromechanics of hydrogels and cellular realignment during contraction.</li>
<li><strong>Laura Liquette (Contractual Researcher - I2M):</strong> Providing computational supervision and technical support for FEniCS-based Finite Element modelling.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>

## {{< iconify fa-solid:laptop-code >}} &nbsp; Advanced Computational Courses

<div class="teaching-card">
<div class="teaching-card-body">
<div class="teaching-text">
<h3>FEniCSx & GMSH Open-Source Tutorials</h3>
<h5>Available Online (v0.9.0) | (v0.10.0 in progress)</h5>
<p>Designed comprehensive open-source Jupyter notebooks and tutorials teaching the use of <strong>FEniCSx</strong> and <strong>GMSH</strong> for finite element modelling. The course covers local installation, Docker deployment, and using Spack for High-Performance Computing (HPC) environments.</p>
